transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because my father-in-law moved in with us, and since then I’ve been more wound up at home. I’m managing at work, but I’ve been short with people at home and with my coursework. I’ve also stopped doing things like fishing, woodworking, and the first-aid workshops that usually help me clear my head.
Aside from feeling wound up, have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most days?
I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling hopeless. Mostly just tense and irritated, especially at home.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in the activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, somewhat. I’ve been skipping fishing, woodworking, and the first-aid workshops lately. Those usually help me clear my head, but I just haven’t been making time for them since my father-in-law moved in.
How long have you been experiencing this tension and irritability?
About four months now—since my father-in-law moved into the house.
How has your sleep been over these past four months?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to my sleep specifically.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels, or have you been feeling unusually tired?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really noticed any particular change in my energy.
Have you noticed any physical sensations like a racing heart, sweating, trembling, or an upset stomach when you feel tense?
I haven’t really noticed those kinds of physical symptoms, no.
